sample.details:
A Group Matchplay competition over a number of rounds where a target of 30 points is set to qualify for the finals.

Once 16 players make the target points, the finals begin. Finals will be the standard Group Knockout format of 3 rounds: going from the 16 qualifiers to 8 to 4, before finding the ultimate winner.
